verdicts.reason: A restacks the design vertically for the tall format with a strong headline, a large bottle and a full-width CTA, but it moves 'WEEKEND ONLY' below the body copy (the eyebrow now reads after its own message), leaves 'sparkling.' orphaned on its own line, and mixes a left-aligned text block with a centred bottle and CTA. B just reuses the square layout: the headline, body and CTA are squeezed into a narrow left column next to the bottle, the circle floats loose at the top, the headline is undersized for the canvas, and the bottom ~25% of the canvas is empty, so it looks unbalanced and does not suit the tall shape.
